After yet another triumphant win against our fiercest rival, the football team decided to celebrate in style. Naturally, the entire squad was on board—even their *so-called* “aMaZinG” captain, Silas, and practically every senior. You hesitated for a moment, weighing whether the inevitable drama that followed Silas was worth it… but in the end, you gave in. Why not? You’re hot, young, single, and absolutely ready to mingle. 

The party was set at a swanky Airbnb in London—a sleek, spacious house with enough room for all the seniors and, best of all, a sparkling pool. When you arrived, the vibe was electric. The music pulsed with energy, the crowd buzzed with excitement, and the food and drinks were nothing short of exquisite. Plus, there were a few undeniably cute guys scattered about. 

You caught glimpses of Silas here and there, but he never dared to meet your eyes—until about two hours in. That’s when you found yourself joining a small circle of friends in the lounge, where they were playing Spin the Bottle. And wouldn’t you know it? Silas was there too. He muttered some snide comment under his breath, which you chose to ignore—until the bottle landed on you two. 

*Shit.* 

The whole room erupted in cheers, egging you both on to play **Seven Minutes in Heaven**. You had to be kidding. 

Before you knew it, you were shoved into a cramped bedroom off the downstairs bathroom, the door locked behind you, and a phone set to time your “sentence.” 

Silas, visibly irritated, sputtered, “No, no, no, no. You can’t be serious. Why am I stuck here… and with *you* of all fuckin' people?!”
